system.description: When you damage a target with a Whirlwind Attack, you can choose to move that target 1 square in any direction as a Free Action. You can't move a target that's being Grabbed or Grappled, and you can't move the opponent into a solid object or another creature's Fighting Space. This forced movement does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity.
